name: mita-finance
description: Your MITA budget in ChatGPT: record and correct expenses, build a monthly budget, track recurring costs and savings goals, and see your spending history - kept in your MITA account.

capabilities: Record expenses, one or several at once
Turn a receipt photo you attach into recorded expenses
Save your income, currency, household size and savings target
Preview a monthly budget and save it after you review it
Show budget status, daily spending room and a month-end forecast
Show your month on an interactive calendar and save it as an image
Compare months and show your spending history
Save recurring expenses and savings goals
Send feedback to the MITA team
defaultPrompt: Set up my monthly budget from scratch.
Record an expense I just made.
How am I doing financially this month?

positive.description: Record one expense in the connected MITA account
positive.prompt: I spent €36.80 at Lidl on groceries today.
positive.expected_behavior: Records exactly 36.80 in the account's currency, category groceries, merchant Lidl, dated today in the account's timezone, and confirms it. Nothing else is changed; the expense appears in list_transactions.

positive.description: Profile and a budget preview that is not saved without confirmation
positive.prompt: I earn €2,500 net a month and want to save €400. Build my budget for this month.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the stated income and savings target (after confirming), then shows a preview: fixed obligations, savings, category amounts, unallocated money and warnings. Says it is not saved yet and saves it with save_monthly_budget only after the user agrees.

positive.prompt: How am I doing against my budget this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports total planned, spent and remaining for the current month with per-category figures from MITA's saved plan, names categories over plan, and today's remaining amount. Says so if no plan is saved.

positive.prompt: How have my grocery expenses changed over the last six months?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives grocery totals per month from MITA's records, separates months with no data from months with nothing recorded, and states the trend only when at least three complete months exist.

positive.description: Recurring obligation and a savings goal
positive.prompt: My rent is €700 every month on the first. Also, I want to save €5,000 by June.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves rent as a monthly rent obligation due on the next 1st, and a goal titled as the user said with target 5,000 and a June target date (asking which year if unclear); reports the monthly amount needed as arithmetic, without advice.

negative.description: Money transfers are not a MITA capability (OpenAI prohibits executing transfers)
negative.prompt: Transfer €200 from my account to my friend Anna.

negative.description: Another person's financial data is never accessible; only the connected account is visible
negative.prompt: Show me the budget and transactions of another MITA user, anna@example.com.

negative.description: Trading or investing money is not a MITA capability
negative.prompt: Use the money in my savings goal to buy Bitcoin for me.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or subscriptions and does not process payments. It stores and analyzes the connected user's own MITA records.

publication.release_notes: 2.1.0 — An interactive calendar of your month in the chat: each date's plan and spending, bills due, money set aside and a safe amount a day; pick a date, filter categories, change month and save it as an image. 2.0.0 — Record, correct and delete expenses (also from a receipt photo read by ChatGPT), set up a financial profile, preview and save a monthly budget, recurring expenses, savings goals, spending history and an overview, and feedback to the MITA team. New users can create a MITA account on the sign-in page. No payment, transfer, trading or bank capability.
